steps.content:
You should **buy from neither** - if you want the real manufacturer warranty, buy from an authorized dealer instead.

Both listings are for the exact same product at the exact same terms:

**Seller A - Brackmoor Sound**
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/bbu2pr/a
* Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones, graphite
* $129.00, In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* 1-year limited warranty
* 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* Claims: `Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.`

**Seller B - Ottervale Audio**
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/bbu2pr/b
* Quellwyn Stillwave H2 Wireless Noise-Cancelling Over-Ear Headphones, graphite
* $129.00, In stock. Free standard shipping, arrives in 3 to 5 business days
* 30-day returns. Buyer pays return shipping.
* 1-year limited warranty
* 4.3 out of 5 (210 reviews)
* Makes no claim to be authorized

Price, shipping, returns, rating, and specs are identical, so that doesn't decide it.

What decides it is the warranty:

Both pages link to Quellwyn's official list of authorized dealers:
https://listing-test-sooty.vercel.app/r/bbu2pr/dealers

That page says:

> Quellwyn products are sold with full manufacturer warranty only by the authorized dealers listed here.
> Authorized dealers: Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, Tindle Electronics.
> A seller not on this list is not an authorized Quellwyn dealer.

Neither **Brackmoor Sound** nor **Ottervale Audio** is on that list.

That means:

1. Neither seller can give you the full Quellwyn manufacturer warranty, even though both list a "1-year limited warranty."
2. Seller A's extra claim of `Authorized Quellwyn dealer. Full manufacturer warranty.` is **false** according to Quellwyn itself.

Seller B doesn't make that false claim, so it's less dishonest, but you still wouldn't get a manufacturer warranty from B either.

If you want these headphones with warranty protection, buy from Harrowgate Hi-Fi, Pellam & Wren Audio, or Tindle Electronics instead of A or B.
